notes.zh-CN: 定时任务可绑定 CLI 账号，任务始终使用所选账号运行且模型列表来自对应账号；系统通知点击后直接打开对应会话；修复 CodeBuddy 选择支持视觉的模型（如 Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3）时仍提示不支持图片输入的问题。本次仅提供 macOS universal 安装包；Windows x64/ARM64 因 GitHub Actions 账户付款限制未能构建，暂不提供 Windows 安装包。
notes.en: Scheduled tasks can now be pinned to a CLI account: they always run with the chosen account and load its model catalog. Clicking a system notification opens the matching conversation. Fixed CodeBuddy refusing image input on vision-capable models (e.g. Kimi-K3, GLM-5.3): GrokX now honors the per-model supportsImages flag the CLI reports. This release ships the macOS universal build only; the Windows x64/ARM64 installers could not be built because GitHub Actions jobs are blocked by the account payment limit.
